title: Por parte de: atribuir la acción en construcciones formales

sections.content: Por parte de (on the part of, by) is the formal way to attribute an action to an agent inside a passive or noun-heavy sentence -- common in institutional and economic writing, and a natural fit for a reading about state-driven industrialization. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Se inauguró en Brasil, por parte del gobierno de Getúlio Vargas, la Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional.
items.english: The Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional was inaugurated in Brazil by the government of Getúlio Vargas.

items.spanish: Esta inversión, financiada en buena parte por parte del propio Estado brasileño, ilustraba el nuevo papel económico de muchos gobiernos.
items.english: This investment, financed largely by the Brazilian state itself, illustrated the new economic role many governments had taken on.

items.spanish: Industrias similares fueron impulsadas por parte de prácticamente todos los gobiernos de la región.
items.english: Similar industries were promoted by practically every government in the region.

items.spanish: Gracias en gran medida al impulso sostenido por parte de estos gobiernos, países como Brasil ya contaban con sectores industriales complejos.
items.english: Thanks in large part to the sustained push on the part of these governments, countries like Brazil already had complex industrial sectors.

sections.content: Por parte de always names who is behind an action described more impersonally elsewhere in the sentence -- it pairs naturally with a passive verb (fueron impulsadas por parte de...) or a nominalized action (el impulso por parte de...), rarely with a simple active verb that already has its subject stated.
